gaps.valueSet: Rule 2 suspected Tularemia diagnosis or active problem
gaps.reason: the source marks both SNOMED and ICD10CM value sets not implemented with no codes, so the wholly inoperable rule is omitted
SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory-result threshold predicate; TUL-R6 retains the coded positive, condition-specific organism, and abnormal-interpretation alternatives

gaps.valueSet: Rules 7 and 8 animal-contact and laboratory-isolate-contact evidence
gaps.reason: the source marks both epidemiologic criteria not implemented, and SEM_V1 has no epidemiologic-contact evidence, so both rules are omitted

SEM_V1 represents laboratory test-name evidence but does not distinguish an order from a completed result observation; the curated rules preserve the source order test-name sets and document this limitation
the source marks the culture, nucleic-acid, and antigen panel value sets not implemented with no codes; the curated rules retain all implemented individual-test branches

gaps.valueSet: Rule 13 ICD10CM and social-history exposure branches
gaps.reason: the source marks the ICD10CM exposure and LOINC social-history-type value sets not implemented with no codes, and SEM_V1 has no social-history evidence; TUL-R13 retains the implemented SNOMED diagnosis and active-problem alternatives
the source identifies death-certificate evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
